description: This file sets up the entry point for a React web application. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS stylesheet, and the main App component. It creates a React root and renders the App component inside a StrictMode wrapper, mounting it onto the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: createRoot
methods.description: Initializes the React rendering root at the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a React element into the root, wrapping it in StrictMode.
